description: Collect both topologies' bench results off the instance via SSM, build the comparison tables, and write the run summary. Depends on FEAT-002 and FEAT-003. Produces (a) whole-machine TP8 preview results table, (b) 4P4D preview results table, (c) side-by-side comparison + conclusion on which topology gives better TPOT/ITL. Summary lands in docs/run-summaries/ parallel to the two prior 2026-09-13 summaries.
steps: Retrieve the raw bench artifacts from the instance via SSM: for both /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out/ (TP8) and /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out-pd/ (4P4D), cat the c*.log summary sections (Successful requests, TTFT/TPOT/ITL median+p90+p99, output/total token throughput, Speculative Decoding accept rate + accept length). Pull the key numbers back through the send-command output.

Build table (a): TP8 preview per-level metrics; table (b): 4P4D preview per-level metrics; table (c): TP8 vs 4P4D side-by-side on out tok/s, TPOT median/p99, ITL median/p99, TTFT, with a verdict on which topology wins on TPOT/ITL. Bold the winning cells. Note the DSpark accept rate/length for each topology (and flag if PD does not surface it through the router).

Write the summary to /projects/sandbox/tpot-benchmark/docs/run-summaries/b300-sglang-preview-dspark-tp8-vs-4p4d-20260914-summary.md following the structure and honesty of the two prior 2026-09-13 summaries (Environment table, 'Did it come up?', Troubleshooting narrative with every blocker + fix, Results tables, Comparison + Verdict, and a 'Not done (by design)' note that the instance/booking were intentionally left running for the orchestrator).

In the summary, explicitly record: whether the preview weight download succeeded (and whether the historical exit1 reproduced); whether TP8 came up (/health, DSpark head attached, accept len); whether 4P4D was stood up (which PD route/transfer backend, blockers + fixes); and the exact instance paths of the result files (/opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out/ and /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out-pd/).
acceptance_criteria: docs/run-summaries/b300-sglang-preview-dspark-tp8-vs-4p4d-20260914-summary.md exists and contains all three tables (a TP8, b 4P4D, c comparison) with a clear TPOT/ITL verdict.

The summary records the four reporting items: weight-download outcome, TP8 bring-up status (health + DSpark head + accept len), 4P4D stand-up status (route/backend + blockers/fixes), and the instance result-file paths.
Numbers in the tables are the actual bench_serving outputs retrieved via SSM, not placeholders; if any topology failed to bench, that is stated honestly rather than fabricated.
verification: Reading the summary confirms tables (a)(b)(c) are populated with real retrieved numbers and the four reporting items are present.
findings:
COMPLETED 2026-09-14. Docs deliverable written; no bench re-run, no server relaunch, no weight re-download. Instance/booking left running per boundaries.

(1) NUMBER VERIFICATION: re-pulled the c1+c16 summary sections of /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out/ (TP8) and /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out-pd/ (4P4D) via one SSM send-command (grep of Successful requests / throughput / TTFT / TPOT / ITL / Accept length). Retrieved numbers matched the FEAT-002/FEAT-003 recorded findings EXACTLY (TP8 c1: out 356.52, total 9863.58, TPOT med 1.20 / p99 1.43, ITL med 1.19 / p99 2.36, TTFT med 1711.26 / p99 3945.79, accept len 5.74; TP8 c16: out 763.33, TPOT med 15.02 / p99 37.13, ITL p99 507.52, TTFT med 4206.86 / p99 23490.85, accept 5.47. PD c1: out 362.76, TPOT med 1.22 / p99 1.47, ITL med 7.07 / p99 7.20, TTFT med 1834.43. PD c16: out 917.70, TPOT med 1.32 / p99 1.56, ITL med 7.12 / p99 8.48, TTFT med 21929.31 / p99 24780.18). The mid-level rows (c2/c4/c8) were taken from the FEAT-002/003 findings (already validated). No placeholders; all real numbers.

(2) DELIVERABLE: docs/run-summaries/b300-sglang-preview-dspark-tp8-vs-4p4d-20260914-summary.md (15.7 KB), following the structure + honesty of the two prior 2026-09-13 vLLM summaries. Contains: Environment table (instance i-0230a688056b553f5, p6-b300.48xlarge 8xB300, acct 077090643075 / us-west-2 / us-west-2a, SSM-only, loopback 127.0.0.1:30080, image lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.17-cu130, model deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark 156G at /opt/dlami/nvme/models/deepseek-ai__DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark, both topology configs, both result paths /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out/ and /opt/dlami/nvme/bench-out-pd/); 'Did it come up?' (weight download succeeded, historical exit1 did NOT reproduce, repo public; TP8 /health 200 + 'Draft checkpoint bundles a DSpark head' + accept 5.5-5.8 + no OOM at 0.90 with flashinfer_mxfp4; 4P4D nixl first try, no GPU collision via explicit --gpus device= pinning, DSpark-on-decode compatible with PD, benign router load_balance_method warning); Troubleshooting (--flush-cache race + manual-pre-flush fix, SGLang range-ratio 1.0 == fixed 40k vs vLLM 0.0, mkdir-before-nohup hiccup); Table (a) TP8 per-level, Table (b) 4P4D per-level, Table (c) side-by-side (out tok/s, TPOT med/p99, ITL med/p99, TTFT med) with winning cells bolded and a VERDICT; 'Not done (by design)' note.

(3) VERDICT recorded honestly: 4P4D wins decisively on TPOT (flat ~1.3 ms vs TP8 rising to 15.02 ms at c16) and on the ITL p99 tail (<=10.96 ms at every level vs TP8's c16 507.52 ms), at the cost of much higher TTFT (c16 ~21.9 s vs ~4.2 s, only 4 prefill cards + PD handoff) and a higher ITL MEDIAN (~7.1 ms vs TP8 ~1.2-2.0 ms). TP8 wins ITL median + TTFT + surfaces DSpark accept stats. DSpark-accept caveat documented for the PD side (not surfaced through the router, same limitation as prior vLLM PD run; DSpark confirmed active from decode startup log).

(4) EM-DASH COMPLIANCE: replaced all 12 template-style em dashes with ':' / '-' / '(...)' per the never-use-em-dashes rule (verified grep count 0). Arrow separators in comparison tables use '→' (not an em dash).

(5) This is a docs-only change: no build/test run (nothing to build). Committed; not pushed (no push required for this deliverable). Instance i-0230a688056b553f5, both topologies' servers (currently PD prefill+decode engines + router), and booking 5bd1f130 LEFT RUNNING; teardown is the orchestrator's call.

(6) REVIEW-FIX ITERATION (v1 review 2026-09-14-031859-review.md, verdict NEEDS_CHANGES, 4 report-accuracy issues, none overturning the headline). All 4 addressed as docs-only edits; NO measured number changed (all verified correct vs raw JSONL), only bolding + clarifying sentences/caveats. (a) Issue 1 (confirmed): table (c) c2 had two unbolded TP8-winning cells; bolded TP8 out tok/s (573.3 vs 523.9) and ITL p99 (2.60 vs 7.85) at c2, and extended the ITL p99 reading note to state TP8's ITL p99 win covers BOTH c1 and c2 (PD ITL p99 win emerges from c4 up). (b) Issue 2 (likely): added a paragraph + reworded the verdict's ITL-median bullet to note the two ITL-median columns are measured differently (PD router per-decode-STEP cadence vs TP8 engine per-token), with the arithmetic 7.1 ms / ~5.5 tokens/step ≈ 1.3 ms ≈ PD TPOT, so 'TP8 wins ITL median' is a measurement-granularity artifact, not a real 6x user-latency win; also softened the inline reading note to point to that. (c) Issue 3: strengthened the DSpark-acceptance caveat with the quantitative indirect bound (~7.1/1.3 ≈ 5.5 accepted tokens/step on PD, comparable to TP8's 5.47-5.76, so the acceptance-driven slice of the delta is probably small) while keeping honest that direct PD acceptance was not measured through the router. (d) Issue 4 (confirmed): added a one-clause acknowledgment under table (a) and in the Throughput verdict bullet that TP8 out tok/s is non-monotonic (356.5 → 573.3 → 511.8 → 780.0 → 763.3, dips at c4 and c16), real measured data reflecting prefill/decode contention on the shared cards, not a transcription error. Em-dash compliance re-verified: grep count 0 (arrows use →). No bench re-run, no server relaunch, no weight re-download, instance/booking still left running.
